title: Ultimate Salts Sherbet Strawberry laces 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Laces from Ultimate Salt’s Sherbet collection is a flavour straight out of sweetshop memories. Those classic strawberry-flavoured gummy laces are blended with fizzy, tangy sherbet to create a truly irresistible flavour. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices and is available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strength. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to the others in Ultimate Puff’s Sherbet Salts collection? From deliciously tangy Lemon Sherbet to unique blends like Strawberry Laces Sherbet, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Ultimate Puff’s Sherbet range has a fabulously fizzy flavour that’s just right for you.
